title: Daily Signal Brief · 2026-07-01 — DevCon 6/2 had two halves; Eglin surfaced one
summary: L3 self-correction: the 2 June Workday DevCon announcement had two halves and the 6/16 brief surfaced only Agent Passport, not the Google Cloud partnership placing Sana Self-Service Agent inside Gemini Enterprise as the default AI model, with A2A + A2UI + MCP protocol coverage and Accenture / Deloitte / KPMG named as global systems integrators. Distribution move, not a feature — the buyer question shifts from 'which HR-AI vendor do I pick?' to 'which HR-AI vendor is already inside the enterprise-AI surface I already bought?' Compass's narrative-shift piece gains a sharper competitive foil (distribution-via-Gemini) and the published-methodology doctrine gets stronger, not weaker. L2 carry-forwards: Digital Omnibus on AI OJ publication is null on day-2 post-Council-adoption (original 2 August 2026 Annex III deadline still legally binding until OJ publishes); Mobley second-plaintiffs'-firm-filing null at D+9 calendar / D+7 business but Seyfarth Shaw's BigLaw 'Agent theory' explainer and University of Miami Law Review's 'Help Wanted, Screened by Algorithms' both surface this week — doctrinal amplification precedes filings waves by 2–6 weeks. Two under-coverages in 48 hours (Lattice MCP 6/30; Gemini Enterprise 7/1) name a structural scan-surface gap; annual-product-event press and distribution-partnership press added to source registry.
